US Intelligence Chief Warns of More Tech Outages Due to Upgrades

US intelligence chief has predicted that more technology outages are likely to occur as systems undergo urgent upgrades. This warning comes amid concerns about potential disruptions, with one report mentioning the Delta airline shutdown that delayed 1,600 flights.
